spans.s: Paurāṇika (EI 30; BL), a reciter of the Purāṇas; also probably, an astrologer. Cf. Vyāsa.

Paura-vīthillaka, probably officers in charge of a city and a subdivision; cf. Paura-vi(vī)thillaka-grāmakūṭa-niyuktāniyukta-pradhān-āpradhāna (Ep. Ind., Vol. XXV, p. 169, where the reading is given as visvillaka).
Paura-vyavahārika, cf. Nagara-vyavahārika. See Hist. Dharm., Vol. III, pp. 112, 147.
